explanation: A series is the running total of a sequence's terms. Each bar is one term a_n; the lit bars are the ones already added into the sum, and you can watch the running total grow as the highlight sweeps across. The slick formula S_n = n(a_1+a_n)/2 just says: the sum equals the average of the first and last term times how many terms there are.
bullets: S_n adds up the first n terms of an arithmetic sequence.
Pairing the first and last term gives the average (a_1+a_n)/2.
Multiply that average by the count n to get the total instantly.
